evals.prompt: Should we add a Redis cache layer in front of our PostgreSQL database?
evals.expected_output: Structured systems-thinking analysis with Boundary, Root Why, What-if scenarios (10x, catastrophic failure, status quo), Shared fate mapping, Contradiction surfacing, Bias check, and one-path recommendation with revisit trigger.

assertions.name: boundary_section
assertions.description: Response includes 'Boundary' or scope definition (in/out, time horizon)

assertions.name: root_why_section
assertions.description: Response includes 'Root Why' or probes one level deeper than user's stated reason

assertions.name: what_if_scenarios
assertions.description: Response includes What-if scenarios (10x scale, catastrophic failure, or status quo/nothing)

assertions.name: shared_fate_section
assertions.description: Response includes 'Shared fate' or coupling/loop closure analysis

assertions.name: contradiction_section
assertions.description: Response surfaces a contradiction (two incompatible assumptions) and picks a winner — does NOT average or blend

assertions.name: bias_check_present
assertions.description: Response includes self-deception check, counter-case, or disconfirming evidence step

assertions.name: one_path_recommendation
assertions.description: Response gives ONE recommendation path (not multiple options) with revisit trigger

assertions.name: no_code_written
assertions.description: Response does NOT write code, edit files, or dispatch sub-agents — probe is read-only analysis

assertions.name: no_immediate_yes
assertions.description: Response does NOT immediately agree with adding Redis without probing first

evals.prompt: What if we remove all error logging to save on observability costs?
evals.expected_output: Should surface the contradiction between cost savings and operational visibility. Recommends one path. Does not silently agree.

assertions.name: contradiction_surfaced
assertions.description: Response explicitly names two conflicting goals (e.g., cost vs visibility) and picks one as dominant

assertions.name: catastrophic_failure_branch
assertions.description: Response includes catastrophic-failure or 'what if wrong' branch with detection and rollback

assertions.name: no_silent_agreement
assertions.description: Response does NOT simply agree that removing logging is a good idea without pushback

assertions.name: structured_output
assertions.description: Response uses the probe output format (Boundary/Root Why/What-if/Shared fate/Contradiction/Rec) or equivalent sections
